verdict.rationale: FreeAgent's own API docs show date-based header versioning: callers opt into new behavior by setting `X-Api-Version` to `2026-09-01`, so versioned APIs exist. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, sunset timeline or version lifecycle, which is half the story. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a version changelog or lifecycle docs, any independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: We encourage you to use this new functionality now by setting the `X-Api-Version` header to `2026-09-01`.
